quote: Ab'xal sells Tier Set Armor on the Champion Track
notes: REPLACES prior item 226206 source-only partial token mapping war-within-20261118-sp01. Wowhead explicitly distinguishes two mutually exclusive vendor reward variants: Ip'xal PvE Hero upgrade track, Ab'xal PvP Champion upgrade track which scales in arenas and battlegrounds. Independently, Method confirms Season 1 initial ilvl 610 (Hero PvE), 597 (Champion PvP) and PvP scaling, https://www.method.gg/guides/where-to-hand-in-mark-of-spelunker-supreme-and-web-wrapped-curio-omni-tokens-in-the-war-within-season-1 . These are track/variant identity facts, not completed reward item IDs. Wowhead source reports no exact reward item IDs/class mapping; keep both variants as null IDs and listComplete=false. Historical Season 1 only; current vendor stock/redemption status unverified. No gear disenchant data, output yields, or current gold value inferred.
